photos.desc: Clonorchis wm uterus and seminal vessicle. Anterior of animal to the right, with more embronated eggs.
Clonorchis, posterior end. Shows testes, the terminus of ceca, excretory bladder, and nephridiopore.
Anterior wm of a Clonorchis. Pharynx, esophabus, branched ceca. By the uterus, one can t race the path to the gonopore, just anterior to the ventral sucker. Vitellene gland is visible on lower left.
Clonorchis anterior showing stoma, oral sucker, pharynx, esophagus, ceca, ventral sucker, and just a bit of uterus
Clonorchis showing posterior uterus, anterior testies, germarium (central ovary), yolk ducts, and seminal recepticle.
Shows ceca, ventral sucker, anterior ovaries with embryonated eggs, and yolk glands
